title: ECOD: Experience-Calibrated On-Policy Distillation for Multi-Turn Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.18656v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Sparse and delayed rewards make reinforcement learning challenging for long-horizon language agents. On-policy distillation (OPD) complements environmental rewards with dense teacher feedback on student-generated contexts. Standard OPD can misalign supervision with relative teacher competence, student trajectory outcomes, and the temporal structure of task execution. Recent variants adjust guidance through divergence-based weighting and temporal schedules, while joint calibration from task-completion experience remains underexplored. We introduce Experience-Calibrated On-Policy Distillation (ECOD), which allocates teacher supervision at the task, trajectory, and turn levels. ECOD compares teacher and student success-rate posteriors under matched task conditions, restricts direct supervision to failed student trajectories, and derives a temporal prior from successful teacher lengths. translated_title: ECOD：面向多轮智能体的经验校准在线策略蒸馏
translated_abstract: 稀疏且延迟的奖励使得强化学习对于长时程语言智能体而言极具挑战性。在线策略蒸馏（OPD）通过在学生生成的上下文上提供密集的教师反馈来补充环境奖励。标准的OPD可能使监督信号与教师的相对能力、学生轨迹的结果以及任务执行的时间结构之间出现错位。近期的变体通过基于散度的加权和时间调度来调整指导，而基于任务完成经验的联合校准仍待深入探索。我们提出了经验校准在线策略蒸馏（ECOD），它在任务、轨迹和轮次三个层面分配教师监督。ECOD在匹配的任务条件下比较教师与学生的成功率后验分布，将直接监督限制在失败的学生轨迹上，并从成功教师轨迹的长度中推导出时间先验。由此得到的权重应用于教师损失或……
tldr: ECOD提出一种经验校准的在线策略蒸馏方法，通过在任务、轨迹和轮次三个层级比较师生成功率后验并引入时间先验来动态校准教师监督强度，从而提升稀疏奖励下长时程多轮智能体的训练效果。
en_tdlr: ECOD is an experience-calibrated on-policy distillation framework that allocates teacher supervision across task, trajectory, and turn levels by comparing teacher-student success-rate posteriors and deriving temporal priors, improving training of long-horizon multi-turn agents under sparse rewards.
